proposals.rationale: Address GMR-001: Explicitly frame the inherent linearity of passive diffraction as a fundamental computational bottleneck early in S01 to logically necessitate the hybrid electro-optical solutions proposed in S07.

Address GMR-010 and GMR-014: Add a bridging paragraph at the start of S02 to justify revisiting foundational training paradigms after S01's discussion of applications, restoring the logical flow from physical design to optimization.
Address GMR-015: Strengthen the transition from S02 to S03 by explicitly connecting training algorithm choices (e.g., differentiability requirements) to specific hardware platform constraints.

Address GMR-002, GMR-004, and GMR-006: Remove the re-explanation of polarization and OAM multiplexing mechanisms in S05, as these are thoroughly covered in S04. S05 should focus strictly on application performance metrics.

Alternative to deletion if content must be retained: Rewrite S05-B003 to remove mechanistic explanations and replace them with explicit references to S04, focusing solely on application-specific outcomes (accuracy, latency).

Address GMR-003, GMR-005, and GMR-007: Condense the reiteration of hardware bottlenecks (static rigidity, fabrication errors) in S07-B001 into a brief transitional summary to avoid redundancy with S03 and S06, preserving momentum for future solutions.
Address GMR-008: Remove the verbatim repetition of the OTEOC strategy description within block S02-B005 to correct the copy-paste error and improve clarity.

Address GMR-009: Remove the detailed explanation of physics-aware differentiable discrete codesign and Gumbel-Softmax from S03, as this methodology is already established in S02. S03 should focus on hardware implications rather than re-explaining training algorithms.

Address GMR-013: Add a bridging explanation to S04-B006 to justify the return to training paradigms (Gumbel-Softmax) in the context of designing high-density multiplexed systems, linking it back to the specific constraints of wavelength/polarization control.

Address GMR-012: Modify the conclusion of S01-B008 to synthesize architectural principles and provide a smoother transition to training/hardware topics, rather than ending abruptly on specialized applications.
